name: Gubber Blump
summary: Along Auberdine’s shore, Gubber Blump fishes, teaches angling, and looks for fresh crab meat.

sections.title: The Angler of Auberdine
sections.body: Gubber Blump fishes on the Darkshore coast, between Auberdine’s flight master and ferry pier. While most dwarves favor stone halls or forges, he chooses the shore. He teaches fishing and sells simple angling gear to travelers. Crab meat is among his favorite foods, and he often relies on travelers to bring in catches from the dangerous coast or recover his family fishing tackle.

sections.title: Family Ties and Ocean Favors
sections.body: Gubber Blump speaks freely about his family, especially his cousin Graun Blump, who has a beard and an unusual odor. Travelers who help with coastal work, such as gathering crawler legs or finding his family pole, may receive a handwritten thank-you letter and a shiny fishing lure for their next cast.

faq.answer: Gubber Blump fishes and teaches angling on Auberdine’s beach, between the village docks and the hippogryph master.

faq.q: What does Gubber Blump teach or sell?
faq.answer: Gubber Blump teaches fishing and sells basic angling gear, including fishing poles and shiny baubles.

faq.q: What tasks does Gubber Blump give out?
aliases: the family and the fishing pole
faq.answer: Gubber Blump asks travelers to find his family fishing pole and gather fine crab meat from the coast.
Graun Blump is Gubber Blump’s dwarven cousin. Gubber says Graun has a beard and an unusual smell.

angles.text: Gubber Blump favors coastal food, especially fresh reef crawler meat, a choice ingredient for cooks gathering food from Darkshore’s waters.
As a dwarf, seeing Gubber Blump settled on a foggy Kalimdor shore instead of Khaz Modan is uncommon. His frank talk about kin still carries his Ironforge roots.
